description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named CustomFieldSearchFilterParams used for filtering custom fields in a search operation within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for screen and field numbers, with accessor and mutator methods to manage these filters.

classes.name: CustomFieldSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filter parameters for custom fields, including allowed sorting fields, screen name, and field numbers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'cf.name'.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the current screen filter value.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen filter to a specified value.

methods.name: getFieldNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of field numbers used as a filter.

methods.name: setFieldNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of field numbers used as a filter.
